name: SCHEMA_NAME
xsd:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" elementFormDefault="qualified" attributeFormDefault="unqualified">
	<xs:element name="test">
		<xs:complexType>
			<xs:sequence>
				<xs:element name="year" minOccurs="0"/>
				<xs:element name="title" minOccurs="0"/>
				<xs:element name="radar" minOccurs="0"/>
			</xs:sequence>
		</xs:complexType>
	</xs:element>
</xs:schema>
xslt:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" version="1.0">
	<xsl:output method="xml" encoding="UTF-8" version="1.0"/>
	<xsl:template match="/">
		<xsl:for-each select="//radar">
			<radar:radarDataset xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:re="http://radar-service.eu/schemas/descriptive/radar/v09/radar-elements" xmlns:radar="http://radar-service.eu/schemas/descriptive/radar/v09/radar-dataset">
				<re:identifier identifierType="RADAR">12/34</re:identifier>
				<re:creators>
					<re:creator>
						<re:creatorName>name</re:creatorName>
					</re:creator>
				</re:creators>
				<re:title>
					<xsl:value-of select="//title"/>
				</re:title>
				<re:publishers>
					<re:publisher>publisher</re:publisher>
				</re:publishers>
				<re:productionYear>
					<xsl:value-of select="//year"/>
				</re:productionYear>
				<re:subjectAreas>
					<re:subjectArea>
						<re:controlledSubjectAreaName>Other</re:controlledSubjectAreaName>
					</re:subjectArea>
				</re:subjectAreas>
				<re:resource resourceType="Other"/>
				<re:rights>
					<re:controlledRights>Other</re:controlledRights>
				</re:rights>
				<re:rightsHolders>
					<re:rightsHolder>rights</re:rightsHolder>
				</re:rightsHolders>
			</radar:radarDataset>
		</xsl:for-each>
	</xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
